technique_name: Describe the impact of the internet on daily life.
description: The internet has had a dramatic impact on everyday life. It has allowed for greater communication and collaboration through email, instant messaging and other forms of digital communication platforms. It has enabled people to connect with others more easily and quickly than ever before, fostering global communities and providing opportunities for relationships to be formed and strengthened.
